title: Sea Turtle Cottage | 5BR Gulf Front Rental in Seagrove Beach
meta_description: Sea Turtle Cottage: 5BR, 4BA Gulf-front home in Seagrove Beach, with a private beach boardwalk and a covered porch. Sleeps 12. Book today!
description_expanded: Description: Sea Turtle Cottage by Royal Destinations Location: Seagrove Beach Address: 68 Sea Turtle Drive Details: Sea Turtle Cottage is a welcoming Gulf-front retreat located along a quiet, gated street in Seagrove Beach. Offering 3,705 square feet of indoor and outdoor living space, this beachfront home comfortably accommodates up to 12 guests with five bedrooms and four full baths. Designed with family gatherings in mind, the home features a vaulted living area, spacious kitchen and dining spaces, and a Gulf-front covered porch perfect for relaxing while taking in the coastal surroundings. Outside, Sea Turtle Cottage offers 50 feet of beach frontage with a private boardwalk leading directly to the sugar-white sand. A spacious yard provides plenty of room for lawn games, while the cozy fire pit creates an inviting place to gather after a day at the beach. With four King bedrooms, a bunk room, multiple laundry areas, and plenty of room for everyone to spread out, Sea Turtle Cottage offers the space, setting, and Gulf-front access for a memorable 30A family vacation. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Distance to Beach Access: Gulf Front with Private Beach Boardwalk -Beach Frontage: Approximately 50 Feet -Parking Spaces: (1) in Garage and (3) in Driveway -Dining Accommodations: Table Seating for 6, Island Seating for 4 -Coffee Maker Available: Drip Coffee Maker and Keurig -Gated Street -Gulf-Front Covered Porch -Private Beach Boardwalk with Shower and Foot Wash -Large Yard -Fire Pit -Outdoor Gas Grill Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 12 5 Bedrooms / 4 Baths Ground Floor: -Bedroom 1: King Bed with Shared Full Bath (Tub/Shower) -Bedroom 2 (Bunk Room): (2) Twin/Twin Bunks with Shared Full Bath (Tub/Shower) -Bedroom 3: King Bed with Private Bath (Tub/Shower) and Gulf-Front Porch Access -Kitchen / Living Room / Dining Area -Gulf-Front Covered Porch -Garage with Additional Refrigerator, Washer and Dryer Second Floor: -Bedroom 4: King Bed with Private Bath (Tub/Shower) and Large Closet with Space for Pack-n-Play -Bedroom 5 (Master): King Bed with Private Bath (Walk-In Shower) -Stackable Washer and Dryer Please Note: *The living room fireplace is decorative only and is not available for guest use. *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
